name: POST /admin/vault/keys - An operator issues a platform-tier (root/app/pool) vault key
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token). Issues a vault key at any tier; root/app/pool keys wrap every tenant, carry no tenant_id, and can ONLY be issued here - the tenant route POST /api/vault/keys refuses them (403 PlatformTier). Below the platform tiers tenant_id is required. Body: tier, kms_ref, algorithm (AES-256-GCM | ChaCha20-Poly1305), region, parent_key_id (required below root, strictly higher tier), scope_id?, tenant_id? (non-platform tiers). 201 { data: key }. This is the parent producer of the tenant-key chain (POST /api/vault/keys), replacing tests/setup_scripts/media_seed_tenant_vault_key.sql. Errors: bad body or tenant_id on a platform tier 400; missing ops token 401.
